name: Invisibility Liquor
summary: Maybell Maclure slips from her family's sight with Invisibility Liquor to meet Tommy Joe Stonefield. Their households remain bound by a bitter feud.

sections.title: A Potion for Star-Crossed Lovers
sections.body: Tommy Joe Stonefield seeks a quiet meeting with Maybell Maclure. But their families' feud keeps the households apart, and their kin watch closely. Ordinary secrecy will not do. Invisibility Liquor lets its drinker cross the disputed farmland unseen.

sections.title: Unorthodox Elwynn Alchemy
sections.body: Crystal Kelp Fronds from waters where murlocs dwell go into the brew. Maybell Maclure drinks the liquor and vanishes from sight. Then she slips into the woods for a secret meeting.

faq.answer: For a short time, Invisibility Liquor makes the drinker invisible. Its magic is carried in an alcoholic drink.
Maybell Maclure receives Invisibility Liquor so she can leave her family's sight and meet Tommy Joe Stonefield, despite their households' feud.
Crystal Kelp Fronds gathered from riverbeds and lake shores in Elwynn Forest go into the brew. Murlocs hoard the plants.

faq.q: Can players drink the Invisibility Liquor themselves?
faq.answer: No. Invisibility Liquor is meant for Maybell Maclure, so she can slip away from her family.

angles.text: As a mage, you know Kirin Tor arcanists spend years mastering illusions and invisibility spells. Elwynn locals make a rough imitation with fermented spirits and waterlogged kelp.
As a human, you know the Stonefield and Maclure clans' rural feud reaches bitter extremes.
